Same B/L 7287216 covers 5 line items on 2025-01-14 (HS 84593990 milling machine, 90173029 tools, 84601900 crank shaft grinding machine, 84581990 lathe, 84623900 press machine). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 10 Records detected", "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 2"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 shipment lines (all dated 2025-01-14, all B/L 7287216, all to Novorossiysk, Russia). So 5 of 10 claimed records were verifiable; the remaining 5 were not displayed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: a real customs shipment dated 2025-01-14, Nhava Sheva (INNSA1) -> Novorossiysk, Russia, consignee VOLGOGRAD METIZ FACTORY LLC, B/L 7287216, machine-tool HS codes. Note the declared HS 845811 (horizontal lathes, numerically controlled) does not match the observed lines: the lathe line is 84581990 (other horizontal lathes, not NC) and the B/L also carries 84593990, 84601900, 84623900 and 90173029. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground - the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actually shipped codes (84581990 / 84593990 / 84601900 / 84623900 / 90173029). Domestic supply evidence could NOT be checked: the web_search tool was non-functional for this batch (searx connection refused on all attempts) and the paid trade portals (volza.com, eximpedia.app) returned HTTP 403. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split was obtained, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found - absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding.
